name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-sync
description: Campaign Studio metrics-sync chain (RFC 0013; campaign gap plan C2 on ADR 0159). Pulls a rolling 7-day look-back of daily ad metrics, with conversions and revenue, for the dispatched campaigns or the whole configured ad account through the acting user's platform connection (ctx.ads; each day's row is replaced on re-pull, so late conversions settle and nothing double-counts) into the unified performance store, then delivers a short sync summary as a notification. Schedule it daily on the ONE scheduler, or run it ad hoc — the 15-minute cooldown makes overlapping fires harmless. Also carries the daily budget-pacing check (ADR 0220). And the hourly conversions delivery (ADR 0907 D7): queued server-side conversions go to the live conversions APIs, consent re-checked per row at send.
author: openwop

chains.label: Daily Ad-Metrics Sync
chains.description: Pull the last 7 days of spend/impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue on one ad platform (meta or google) into the performance store — the dispatched campaigns, or every campaign of the configured ad accounts (connector settings, or the syncScope parameter) — per-account best-effort, deduped, cooldown-guarded — and notify with the result. Pair with a daily schedule for hands-off freshness (feeds the KPI cards, budget recommendations, and the attribution join).

orgId.description: The org whose performance store receives the rows.

platform.description: The ad platform to pull (the two with live metrics readers).

syncScope.description: Override the org's connector setting for this run: only the campaigns this app launched, or every campaign of the configured ad accounts. Omit to use the setting.

chains.label: Daily Budget Pacing Check
chains.description: Compare every campaign's actual spend (performance store) against its budget plan and notify on band escalations (80% warning / 100% over) — once per escalation, never per run. Pair with a daily schedule after the metrics sync.

orgId.description: The org whose campaigns are paced.

alerted.description: Band escalations that raised a notification.

chains.label: Hourly Conversions Delivery
chains.description: OFF until the workspace enables the `campaign-connectors.scheduled-conversions` toggle (an honest `disabled` no-op until then). Deliver the org's queued server-side conversions (Meta CAPI; TikTok and Google once verified) through the schedule owner's ad connections. Consent is re-checked per row at send — withdrawn consent drops the row, unreadable consent holds it. Pair with an HOURLY schedule: platforms accept events up to 7 days old, and an hourly run keeps the visitor's IP and user agent on the row for hours, not days (they are dropped once every platform has the event). A 15-minute cadence would be 96 runs per org per day, mostly empty. Events older than a platform's window are marked expired, never sent, so enabling it never flushes an old backlog.

orgId.description: The org whose queued conversions are delivered.

sent.description: Rows every applicable platform now has.

dropped.description: Rows dropped because consent was withdrawn.

held.description: Rows held for the next run (consent unreadable or no visitor key).

expired.description: Rows past every remaining platform's window — marked expired, not sent.
